Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 49-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.51, bnp 1399, creatinine 0.8, hemoglobin 14, platelets 282, sodium 139, wbc 7.6; vitals dbp 68-72, heart_rate 80-85, map 88-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 129-136, spo2 95-96, temp 36.8-37
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 40 mg IV; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 34%, global hypokinesis
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. CHF.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.83, hemoglobin 14, platelets 274, sodium 139, wbc 7.6; vitals dbp 67-70, heart_rate 79-85, map 88-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 129-135, spo2 95-97, temp 36.8-37
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 40 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. CHF. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 49-year-old male, length of stay 5 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. CHF. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
